title.narrative: UNICEF Angola supported the Government to approve the Food Security and Nutrition Strategy, establishing a national framework for sustainable food production, improved access to nutritious food, and prevention of child malnutrition. In priority provinces, 460,332 children were screened for SAM and 76,877 received quality treatment through UNICEF's essential nutrition supplies.
A nutrition policy or strategy to prevent undernutrition and micronutrient deficiencies in children under 5 years exists and is being implemented
